RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

SAMPLE DOCUMENT — fictional parties, created to test LeaseLookout. Not a real lease.

This Lease is made between Maple Ridge Properties LLC ("Landlord") and Jordan Sample ("Tenant") for the premises at 12 Sample Street, Apt 3, Middletown, CT 06457 (the "Premises").

Term: Twelve (12) months, September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027. Rent: $1,800.00 per month.

1. Rent and Payment

Monthly rent of $1,800.00 is due on the 1st of each month. Rent is payable only by electronic funds transfer (ACH); cash, checks, and money orders are not accepted.

2. Late Charges

A late charge of $100.00 is due on the day rent is unpaid, with an additional $25.00 per day thereafter until paid in full.

3. Security Deposit

Tenant shall pay a security deposit of three (3) months' rent prior to occupancy. The security deposit is non-refundable. Landlord may deduct for repainting and routine cleaning from the deposit upon move-out.

4. Move-In Fee

A non-refundable move-in fee of $250.00 is due at signing, in addition to the security deposit.

5. Landlord Access

Landlord or its agents may enter the Premises at any time without notice for any purpose Landlord deems appropriate.

6. Repairs and Condition

Tenant shall be responsible for all repairs and maintenance to the Premises, structural or otherwise. Tenant accepts the Premises as-is and waives the implied warranty of habitability.

7. Utilities

If rent is past due, Landlord may shut off utilities and other essential services to the Premises until the balance is paid in full.

8. Waiver of Rights

Tenant waives any and all rights and remedies under Chapter 830 of the Connecticut General Statutes and under any applicable municipal ordinance.

9. Indemnification

Tenant agrees to hold the Landlord harmless from any and all claims, damages, and liabilities arising from the condition or use of the Premises.

10. Default and Remedies

Upon any default, Landlord may re-enter and dispossess the Tenant without resorting to court process. Tenant confesses judgment in favor of the Landlord for all sums then due under this Lease.

11. Early Termination

Upon early termination by Tenant, Tenant owes all accelerated rent for the entire remainder of the Term, due immediately.

12. Quiet Enjoyment

Tenant shall be entitled to quiet enjoyment and peaceful possession of the Premises during the Term.

13. Pets

No pets are permitted without the prior written consent of the Landlord.
